'''Kamasto''' was a frigid [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], where it [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] an orange dwarf. The world was the site of a number of monasteries that were operated by the [[Children of Mani]], before the religion was divided by a schism. The world was later the site of a number of unsuccessful acts of diplomacy. Between [[3701 BBY]] and [[3699 BBY]] the Hydian Way was charted through Kamasto as part of the [[Seswenna Expansion]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
